$doc: CC-ORTHO-SWEEP-ALL: generator rules and seed pairs handed to CC-SENSE-CUE (it owns the table, its status and the read API). Nothing here changes grading. kind true = identical sound in this voice; accent = differs for some speakers or in some voices, never accepted as a homophone.
status: table verified (7 true sets) by CC-SENSE-CUE; es_scz and the tilde rule need a re-check against the Spain voice

rules.description: b and v are one phoneme
ll and y merge (yeismo); true for the es-ES-Neural2-G voice
c/z against s. The Spain voice distinguishes them (distincion), so casa/caza is NOT a same-sound pair here; it would be true for a seseante voice
a pair that differs only by a written tilde sounds the same in isolation (tu/tú, el/él, si/sí)
